notes: Makes ChatGPT result return reliable on iPhone. Paste Results now accepts only a valid tee-chatgpt-extract-v1 JSON result from the clipboard. If iOS blocks clipboard reading or the clipboard still contains the analysis request, TEE opens Manual Paste with an empty box and explicit tap-inside → Paste → Apply Manual Result instructions instead of applying the wrong text. ChatGPT guidance now includes first-time login and exact Copy steps. Vault behavior and private data are unchanged.
name: TEE v3.4.24 — Reliable ChatGPT Result Paste
